name: Trospium pivotal trials
question: Does immediate-release trospium chloride 20 mg twice daily improve overactive bladder symptoms compared with placebo over 12 weeks?

design.population: 523 patients with overactive bladder and urge incontinence were randomized at 51 sites; 512 (256 per arm) entered the intention-to-treat efficacy analysis.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase III randomized trial
design.locator: Full text, Results and Tables 1–2, pp 2312–2313

verdictNote: Both coprimary diary endpoints improved in the intention-to-treat analysis at week 12.
takeaway: In Zinner's 12-week phase III trial, trospium chloride 20 mg twice daily reduced daily toilet voids by 2.37 versus 1.29 with placebo and urge incontinence episodes by 59.0% versus 44.2% (both P ≤0.0001; intention-to-treat, last observation carried forward).

reports.label: Zinner placebo-controlled trial
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation, June 2004; day not reported
reports.citation: Zinner N, Gittelman M, Harris R, et al. "Trospium Chloride Improves Overactive Bladder Symptoms: A Multicenter Phase III Trial." *J Urol.* 2004;171(6 Pt 1):2311-2315. doi:10.1097/01.ju.0000127742.73136.0c
reports.followUp: 12 weeks; coprimary effects by week 1, nocturnal effect by week 4, IIQ improvement at week 12
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Study design and Table 2, pp 2312–2313

results.measure: Week-12 change in average toilet voids per 24 hours; intention-to-treat, last observation carried forward (256 per arm)
results.note: Difference calculated from rounded arm changes; confidence interval not reported.

results.measure: Week-12 percent change in urge incontinence episodes per 24 hours; intention-to-treat, last observation carried forward (256 per arm)
results.note: Effect is the percentage-point difference calculated from rounded arm changes; confidence interval not reported.

results.measure: Week-12 change in nocturnal voids per 24 hours; intention-to-treat, last observation carried forward (256 per arm)
results.note: Between-group difference first reached significance at week 4 (−0.43 vs −0.17, P ≤0.001); week-12 difference calculated from rounded arm changes; no confidence interval reported.

results.measure: Week-12 change in total Incontinence Impact Questionnaire score; intention-to-treat, last observation carried forward
results.note: Least-squares mean changes; improvement significant in women (−59.1, n=183 vs −35.7, n=169), not men; difference calculated from rounded arm changes, no confidence interval reported.
results.locator: Full text, Table 3 and Results, p 2313

results.measure: Week-12 change in mean voided volume per void; intention-to-treat, last observation carried forward (256 per arm)
results.note: Difference calculated from rounded arm changes; no confidence interval reported.
Reported percentages; response denominators and a P value are not supplied.

harms.label: Adverse events leading to discontinuation
harms.note: Event counts not reported; overall discontinuation was 16.4% in each arm.

delivery.label: Oral treatment
delivery.value: Trospium chloride 20 mg twice daily or placebo for 12 weeks, randomized 1:1.
